searchWordsRelease.change: Picture searches: results qualify on their own score (their place only orders them); words the search asks for are not held against a title; guide, data and download pages are; a Chinese title must name the thing (half its characters), and an English title sharing no word with a several-word search for a Chinese name does not count for it. A search that finds nothing worth fetching is tried without its kind-of-picture words, then without its last word. An encyclopedia redirect to another article (a list with the Pokemon logo) is not the thing.
